newsitem.title: CANADA: Nipsco to acquire Canadian gas marketer.
newsitem.headline: Nipsco to acquire Canadian gas marketer.

text.p: Nipsco Industries Inc unit Nipsco Energy Services Inc said on Thursday it agreed to buy a majority stake in Canadian natural gas marketing and trading firm Chandler Energy Inc for an undisclosed sum.
Following the acquisition, Chandler Energy, which currently transports about one billion cubic feet per day of gas, will become known as NESI Energy Marketing Canada Ltd., the companies said.
The deal will allow Merrillville, Indiana-based Nipsco to increase gas marketing and trading activities in Canada and the U.S. Midwest, it said.
The companies said Bruce Chandler will become NESI Canada's chief executive and Curtis Chandler its president and chief operating officer. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
